const add = (a: number, b: number): number => {
  return a + b;
};

const classify = (n: number): string => {
  if (n < 0) {
    return "negative";
  }
  return "positive";
};

const makeAdder = (base: number) => {
  return (x: number) => {
    if (x > 0 && base > 0) {
      return x + base;
    }
    return base;
  };
};

const items = [1, 2, 3].map((x) => {
  if (x % 2 === 0) {
    return x * 2;
  }
  return x;
});

async function fetchThing(url: string): Promise<number> {
  const result = await doFetch(url);
  if (result) {
    return 1;
  }
  return 0;
}

function doFetch(url: string): number {
  return url.length;
}
